entries.speaker: Praying at the Shrine
entries.en: Praying at the Meiji Shrine will strengthen the bond[n]that you have with one of your [clr 2]Confidants[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Praying at the Shrine
entries.en: A large donation will increase the chance of your [n]wish being granted. You can even deepen bonds[n]with Confidants who you cannot meet on that day.
